mapper.insert: insert into sys_staff_amount_record (staff_id, staff_account, order_no, order_amount, ratio, income_amount, record_type, settle_status, remark, create_time, update_time, is_deleted) values (#{staffId}, #{staffAccount}, #{orderNo}, #{orderAmount}, #{ratio}, #{incomeAmount}, #{recordType}, #{settleStatus}, #{remark}, now(), now(), 0)
mapper.select: select * from sys_staff_amount_record where record_type = 1 and settle_status = 0 and is_deleted = 0 and create_time <= #{beforeTime} order by id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update sys_staff_amount_record set settle_status = 1, settle_time = #{settleTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and settle_status = 0 and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_staff_amount_record r join sys_staff s on s.id = r.staff_id where r.is_deleted = 0
select * from sys_staff_amount_record where order_no = #{orderNo} and staff_id = #{staffId} and record_type = 1 and is_deleted = 0 limit 1
